questions.stem: For data set 1, a sensor lab repeats a value 3 times across 4 rows; how many cells result?

questions.stem: For data set 2, an array holds 12 elements; what is the index of its final element?

questions.stem: For data set 3, a film studio records the remainder when 53 is divided by 6; what value is printed?

questions.stem: For data set 5, an engineer computes the C expression 7 << 2; what integer results?
